title: FLASH Protocol for RNA Processing and Analysis
author: Ibrahim Ilik
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.zv9f696
materials: Re-suspend the beads with 7µL of room-temperature, RNase-free water. Add 1µL of selected s-oligo (10µM). Add the rest of the ligation mix. Incubate @ 25˚C for 60 minutes PEG8000 and ATP is shipped with T4 RNA Ligase, when ordered from NEB. PEG8000 is extremely viscous, and that is the reason why the reaction is set up in this way (first water, then adapter, then the rest). Adapters are internally barcoded (TGTAGC below). It is possible to mix negative controls (GFP-expressing cell line, parental cell line, point mutant that is supposed to not bind RNA etc) with the sample after ligation. This allows us to evaluate background very precisely and filter false-positives efficiently. The adapters are key to the success of this protocol. They basically look like this: This adapter is ligated to RNA via T4 RNA ligase. The self-annealed part then is used as a reverse-transcription primer. At the end of reverse transcription, RNaseH is used to remove RNA and create a 5’-phosphate at the edge of the adapter. This cDNA molecule is then circularized by CircLigase (requires 5’-phosphate) and then PCR-amplified (adapter is based on the Y-shape adapter of Illumina and contains P5 and P3 sequence for amplification). We have a patent application for it too: WO/2017/013005

steps.title: UV crosslink cells
steps.instruction: Place cells (e.g., half of a 15 cm plate) on ice water, wash twice with ~6 mL ice‑cold PBS, then irradiate with UV‑C at 0.15–0.2 mJ cm⁻² (lamp 3–6 cm away).

steps.title: Harvest and freeze cells
steps.instruction: Spin cells at 1 000 g for 1 min, discard PBS, snap‑freeze pellet in liquid nitrogen and store at –80 °C until use.

steps.title: Lyse cells with NLB and sonicate
steps.instruction: Resuspend pellet in 600 µL 1× NLB, sonicate in a Bioruptor Plus (5 cycles, LOW, 30 s ON/30 s OFF).

steps.title: Clarify lysate
steps.instruction: Spin lysate at 20 000 g for 10 min, collect supernatant for downstream IP.

steps.title: Bind lysate to His‑tag beads
steps.instruction: Wash 25 µL Dynabeads™ His‑Tag Isolation beads once with 1× NLB, resuspend in 500 µL NLB, add lysate, pipette 2–3×, incubate 5–10 min on ice (no rotation), then wash beads once with 1× NLB.

steps.title: Elute His‑tagged protein
steps.instruction: Elute beads with 0.5 mL 1× NLB containing 250 mM imidazole for 5 min on ice (50 mM imidazole also works). Elution buffer is made from 2× NLB stock, 2 M imidazole (pH 8.0) and water.

steps.title: Capture biotinylated complexes
steps.instruction: Add eluate to 25 µL MyOne™ Streptavidin C1 beads in 500 µL NLB, incubate 45 min in the cold‑room (30 min–2 h acceptable), then wash once with HSB and once with NDB.

steps.title: RNase I digestion of bound RNA
steps.instruction: Resuspend beads in 90 µL NDB, add 10 µL RNase I diluted in NDB (final 1:500–1:2000, recommend 1:2000), incubate 37 °C for 3 min, keep on ice 1 min, wash with HSB then NDB.

steps.title: Dephosphorylate RNA 3′ ends
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL MES‑PNK mix, incubate 37 °C for 20 min, then wash once with HSB and once with NDB. Use T4 PNK (not phosphatase‑minus) and include β‑mercaptoethanol.

steps.title: Wash and merge samples
steps.instruction: Wash beads once with HSB, merge all relevant samples, then wash sequentially with LDS‑buffer (RT), PLB buffer (RT), 1× HSB (cold), and 1× NDB (cold).

steps.title: Remove 3′ blocking phosphate
steps.instruction: Resuspend beads in 35 µL NDB, add 1 µL RNasin⁺ and 4 µL rSAP, incubate 37 °C for 15 min, then wash once with HSB and once with NDB.

steps.title: Proteinase K digestion
steps.instruction: Prepare proteinase‑K mix: 50 µL 2× ProK buffer, 1 µL 20 % SDS, 10 µL Proteinase K, 39 µL H₂O (total 100 µL). Resuspend beads in this mix and incubate 42 °C for 20 min.

steps.title: Purify RNA with Oligo Clean kit
steps.instruction: Magnetize beads, discard supernatant, transfer to a new tube. Bind RNA with 200 µL Binding Buffer and 400 µL ethanol, wash as per kit, elute in 10.5 µL RNase‑free water.

steps.title: Reverse transcription
steps.instruction: Heat RNA eluate at 65 °C for 2 min, place on ice 1 min, add reverse‑transcription mix (per SuperScript III manual), incubate 42 °C 10 min → 50 °C 10 min → 55 °C 10 min.

steps.title: RNase H treatment of cDNA
steps.instruction: Cool RT reaction to RT, add 2 µL E. coli RNase H (2 U µL⁻¹), incubate 37 °C for 20 min (alternatives: other RNase H1‑type enzymes).

steps.title: Circularize cDNA
steps.instruction: Set up 10 µL reaction: 1 µL 10× Buffer, 0.5 µL 50 mM MnCl₂, 20.5 µL 5 M Betaine, 2 µL CircLigase II, 0.5 µL cDNA. Incubate 60 °C for ≥2 h (CircLigase can be used with ATP).

steps.title: Optional NaOH cleanup
steps.instruction: Add 2.5 µL 1 N NaOH, incubate 80 °C for 5 min, then neutralize with 25 µL 0.2 M Tris.

steps.title: qPCR to determine PCR cycles
steps.instruction: Set up qPCR using 1 µL of the circularization reaction with primers PrimerL (TACACGACGCTCTTCCGATCT) and PrimerR (GACGTGTGCTCTTCCGATCT) to estimate optimal cycle number (typically Ct‑1).

steps.title: PCR amplify library
steps.instruction: Amplify the remaining circularization product with NEBNext® Ultra™ II Q5® Master Mix using appropriate Illumina dual‑index primers (e.g., NEBNext Multiplex Oligos Set 1).

steps.title: Purify amplified cDNA
steps.instruction: Use Oligo Clean and Concentrator Kit: if NaOH step was performed, bind with 100 µL Binding Buffer + 200 µL ethanol; otherwise add 28 µL water to RT reaction then bind with 100 µL Binding Buffer. Elute in 6.5 µL water.

steps.title: Double AMPure XP cleanup
steps.instruction: Add 60 µL (1.5×) AMPure XP beads to the reaction, incubate 5 min, magnetize and discard supernatant. Wash beads twice with 500 µL freshly‑prepared 70 % ethanol (do not resuspend). Air‑dry 1–2 min, elute DNA with 40 µL 10 mM Tris pH 8.0 + 0.05 % Tween‑20, incubate RT 1–2 min, magnetize, transfer eluate to a fresh tube and repeat the same purification. Elute final library in 10–20 µL 10 mM Tris pH 8.0 + 0.05 % Tween‑20.

steps.title: Quantify and assess library
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration with Qubit (or similar dsDNA assay) and evaluate size distribution on an Agilent Bioanalyzer 2100, Fragment Analyzer, or equivalent. Library is ready for sequencing; UMI and index are located in the first 13 nt of R2 reads (pattern NNNNNXXXXXXNN).
